problem: Enterprise agent SDLC kit requires documented configurable acceptance rules for dependency vulnerability management. Currently undefined: high/critical vulnerability blocking criteria and low/moderate vulnerability acceptance thresholds for PR merging.
outcome: Documented acceptance rules that specify: high/critical dependency vulnerabilities block PR merging; low/moderate vulnerabilities may proceed with documented risk acceptance.
constraints: Rules must be configurable per project or global defaults
Blocking rules for high/critical vulnerabilities are non-negotiable
Low/moderate vulnerability acceptance must include audit trail
Rules must integrate with existing CI/CD pipeline
exclusions: Does not include deployment or approval of these rules
Does not establish organizational policy or override existing approvals
Does not modify workflow or deployment settings beyond documentation
Does not require security team sign-off at proposal stage
evidence: Missing: Formal security requirements specification for vulnerability thresholds
Missing: Integration points and dependencies for CI/CD systems
Missing: Owner and approval chain for implementation decision
Missing: Risk assessment for low/moderate vulnerability acceptance policy
